- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Varanasi is one of the oldest cities in the world and is considered the holiest city in Hinduism; bathing in the Ganges River can purify sins and liberate from the cycle of birth and death.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Haridwar is an important pilgrimage site for Hindus, located at the foothills of the Himalayas; it is popular for the Ganga Aarti ritual.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tirupati is a temple town in Andhra Pradesh, home to the Sri Venkateswara Temple, one of the most visited and wealthiest temples in the world, dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amritsar is the spiritual and cultural center of Sikhism, home to the Golden Temple, the holiest gurdwara in the world, symbolizing harmony and brotherhood.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bodh Gaya is where the Buddha attained enlightenment under the Bodhi tree, one of the four holiest pilgrimage sites for Buddhists.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rishikesh is a spiritual hub known for yoga and meditation retreats, believed to lead to spiritual enlightenment and self-realization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ajmer is home to the Dargah Sharif, the tomb of Sufi saint Moinuddin Chishti, attracting pilgrims from various religions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Puri is home to the Jagannath Temple, dedicated to Lord Jagannath, attracting thousands of devotees, especially during the Rath Yatra festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the site of the ancient capital of the Vijayanagara Empire, home to important Hindu temples.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kedarnath is one of the four sacred shrines in Hinduism known as the Char Dhams, believed to grant moksha.
